name: Nagaimono ni wa Makarero! ~ Watashidake no Chouhatsu Danshi ~
original_name: 長いものには巻かれろ！ ～私だけの長髪男子～
source:
You’re just an ordinary girl who loves guys with long hair...
One day, while out looking for a little excitement, you run into a handsome long-haired man...!?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/14181]Novelgame[/url]]
